text: I'm Sefa, Amir scout for the Watch. You walk loud for a warrior. Want a tip?
In a fight, your ring creature AND you both act each turn.
STRIKE with your blade, or GUARD: you take every blow at half damage and shield your creature.
If YOU fall, you black out - even if your creature can still fight. Mind your health!
Creatures hide in the tall grass on the Hollow Road, north of town.
Weaken one, then use RING to bind it. Low health means a better chance.
